Subject: Acme procurement - next steps (post-call recap)

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has everything in one place: 

Call summary:
- Priority: pilot in December, production early Q1.
- Commercial path discussed: pilot on card / corporate card, production via PO and invoice.
- Marketplace was mentioned as an alternative distribution path — you said procurement will confirm if that’s preferred.

Action items for Acme:
1) Confirm preferred purchase path (PO + invoice vs. marketplace vs. card for pilot).
2) Share any standard purchase order requirements (billing address, remit-to, contact for invoicing).
3) Let us know if you need a standard MSA / redlines from our legal team.

What I’m attaching: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW) and Pricing_Sheet.xlsx (pilot/production bands). If PO is the path we can also send an order form via DocuSign to speed signature.

Proposed next step: weekly check-in cadence (15-min) — I’ll follow up each Monday until procurement is green. Would Monday 11/8 at 10am PT work for a short sync?

Thanks — happy to jump on procurement calls if helpful.

—
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Acme procurement - next steps (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from procurement:
- We expect to use a PO + invoice for production. For the pilot, our procurement team prefers corporate card if the amount is under the internal pilot threshold; otherwise we’ll do a PO.
- I’ve asked procurement@acme.com to share our PO template and any special billing fields — will loop that back to you.
- Marketplace: we can evaluate but marketplace purchases need an internal business case; that will likely add time to delivery. For speed, PO direct to vendor is preferred.

We’ll review the SOW and pricing and come back with any questions.

Thanks —
Jamie
Head of Procurement | Acme Corp
jamie.carter@acme.com

Thanks Jamie — that helps. Per procurement preference, we’ll prioritize PO + invoice for production and card for the pilot if it fits your threshold. I’ve attached the SOW and pricing again for procurement’s review.

If helpful, two commercial paths we commonly use:
- Pilot (low friction): Corporate card, single-month charge, then convert to PO for production.
- Production (preferred by larger accounts): PO + net 30 invoicing, Redwood sends invoice after DocuSign execution of order form/statement of work.

If you’re open to marketplace, we can draft a marketplace purchase order too — note that marketplace onboarding can add ~2–4 weeks depending on internal processes.

Action for us: I’ll send an order form via DocuSign if procurement confirms PO path so your approvers see a familiar workflow. Order_Form_DocuSign_link.txt (link included)

Open items for Acme:
- Confirm desired billing path (PO vs marketplace vs card pilot)
- Provide PO template / billing fields (procurement@acme.com)
- Any required insurance or security docs to attach to PO (we have SOC2 report and ISO guidance available)

I can join a procurement call if it speeds things up — open to joining with Jonas or Monica.

Best,
Marissa
